mandate: Opens the tender box on the closing day, lists offers in the Jadual Tawaran in opening order, numbers and initials each tender, enters the department estimate, signs.
notes: Composition is stated: exactly two appointed Ranhill SAJ Executive officers. Appointment mechanics are deferred to OM/KP/SP/002, which is not in the corpus. No independence requirement is stated, although in observed practice the two officers came from Accounts & Finance and Group IT, deliberately outside C&P. No quorum stated.

mandate: Opens quotations and signs the schedule of quotations.
notes: Composition is nowhere defined. No quorum stated. RSAJ must supply both.

mandate: Gives a mandatory, non-delegable recommendation on direct-purchase appointment above RM15,000 and up to RM300,000; on open and selective appointment in the same band; and on extension of contract period for term contracts in the quotation band. The CEO approves.
notes: Composition is observed only, from the evaluation template APPROVAL sheet: a Chairman, a Deputy Chairman and two member rows, each with alternates separated by '/'. §5.2 directs that this be modelled as a role with an eligible-member pool, not fixed individuals. No quorum stated. Each member signs SETUJU or TIDAK SETUJU with a date.

mandate: Established by the Board of Directors to approve tenders, extension of the contract period for term contracts, delay and extension of time, and variation of works. Also holds the exclusive power to decide whether a late tender may be opened and evaluated.
notes: Quorum of three members is the only stated quorum in the entire pre-award corpus. Composition is not stated: the DAL says 'as set out in the DAL and the TOR' and the TOR is not in the corpus. Observed: five members chaired by a Director, with the CEO, COO, CFO and Head of Quality Management Division as members.

mandate: Mandatory, non-delegable recommendation on every variation order and every delay-and-EOT row in the tender regime, and on variations above 20% in the quotation regime.
notes: Composition is observed and the two observations disagree. KP002 flowchart 6.3 names a Chairman of COO and CFO with members from Planning & Development, Production & M&E, Quality Management and Finance & Contract. The PAAB consent form prints a nine-member committee. Names are hard-coded on the template. No quorum stated. Under SK006 §7.6.1 as amended this body also approves EOT with no financial impact, which conflicts with the DAL — see decision D2.

mandate: Decides the First Stage technical evaluation for Design & Build and Turnkey tenders — design, materials, structural, mechanical and electrical. Also approves specialist and sole-source repair methods.
notes: Composition, quorum, appointment authority, chair, output document and decision rule are all unstated. This body does not appear on the SK003 flowchart at all.

mandate: Approves technical working papers and project proposals; sets scope for emergency works.
notes: A committee gate that sits outside every DAL matrix. Composition and quorum unstated.

mandate: Approves contractor loss and expense claims before the Final Account on Service contracts.
notes: Appears in no other document in the corpus. On Work contracts the same gate sits with the Tender Board (KP002 5.12.5); KP004 has no clause at all. Not referenced by any DAL authority row.

mandate: Consents to variation orders affecting PAAB-funded assets, decided AGREE or DISAGREE on form CPD/VO(CONSENT)-PAAB.
notes: External to Ranhill SAJ. Its decision is a precondition, not a Ranhill SAJ approval — it consents rather than approves, which is why it carries no authority act in the DAL grammar. Nine members are named on the printed template.
